latestVersion.changelog:
compliance-posture-intake v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Provides a guided HIPAA compliance posture assessment using conversational intake.
- Covers all Seven Elements of an effective compliance program.
- Chains document analysis (HIPAA gap analysis, BAA review, framework mapping, compliance QA, and control assessment) if documents are provided.
- Produces a structured report with maturity stage, blockers, gap prioritization, and a 30/60/90 day roadmap.
- Compatible with any agent or API context with rote-compliance-toolkit integration.
